user_query: I need the Hebrew date for March 17th, 2021. Also, fetch the events from my selected calendar and define a custom period for my upcoming vacations from June 1st, 2022 to June 10th, 2022.

TaskList.description: Convert the Gregorian date March 17th, 2021, to the Hebrew calendar date.
Fetch events from the user's selected calendar during a specified timeframe.
Define the custom vacation period from June 1st, 2022, to June 10th, 2022, and check for any conflicts with existing events.
